t: The 4lite square LED CCT panel is a high-performance lighting solution designed for recessed installation in shallow ceiling voids. This 600mm x 600mm LED panel is ideal for commercial environments such as offices, schools, and workshops, providing versatile illumination. It features variable white colour temperature settings, offering 3000K, 4000K, and 6500K to suit different tasks and preferences. Delivering 3600 lumens, the panel ensures bright and efficient lighting. Constructed with a durable steel body and a white steel frame, it includes a plastic diffuser for even light distribution and boasts an impressive life of up to 54,000 hours.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
